analysis: The model was explicitly listed by /v1/models but did not complete either bounded request within 45 seconds. This is availability/latency evidence, not cognitive evidence. No routing or parsing change is authorized.
decision: Keep the deployment evidence-only; preserve fail-closed behavior and investigate the campaign timeout reporting path offline before another live probe.
